UI_trait_regretnothing_desc: Nothing rattles you anymore. Panic doesn't get a grip, violence barely registers, and you've made peace with whatever it takes to keep breathing. Light one up or pop a few pills, and your next hit lands harder.
UI_ETW_aaa_TranslationVersion: This is a note for translators, please do not translate. Set translation version to the latest ETW release you are translating for. This is used to track which translation is up-to-date and which is not.
UI_ETW_GainLoseTooltip: You will gain/lose the trait when bar is around here (or qualify for gaining/losing it, if Delayed Traits System is on and this trait in that system)
UI_ETW_GainTooltip: You will gain the trait when bar is around here (or qualify for gaining it, if Delayed Traits System is on and this trait in that system)
UI_ETW_Help_FAQ: <H1> FAQ <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: How do I stop/change the sound notifications? How do I resize window? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Esc -> Options -> Mod Options. There are also some other options sprinkled in there <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: How do I get trait XYZ? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Hover your mouse over UI elements. There are a lot of tooltips which explain stuff. If it's still not understandable, check sandbox tooltips. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: Text in UI overlaps, how to fix? <LINE> <TEXT> A: There are some settings in Mod Options that might help. UI is designed to try to automatically account for different font sizes, but it is DESIGNED to be used with english language and Game Options -> User Interface (UI) -> Font Size set to 16px. Different languages and font sizes might cause some overlapping despite my efforts to make it auto-resize <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: Difference between Permanent and Non-Permanent tabs? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Permanent tab shows traits that have only one direction of progression, and once you gain or lose them, they are permanent. The progression on that tab is 'Lose bad trait' -> 'Gain good trait' and anything in between. Non-Permanent tab shows traits that can be gained and lost multiple times, so progression goes 'Gain bad trait' <-> 'Lose bad trait' <-> 'Lose good trait' <-> 'Gain good trait'. Vitals tab is equivalent to 'Non-permanent' tab, but it shows only vitals-related traits as those averages can affect rate of gaining/losing other traits <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: I gained a trait but my skill levels didn't change? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Intended. Gaining a trait doesn't change your skill levels, but it changes your exp multiplier for those skills and any additional special mechanics that come with traits.

UI_ETW_Options_GatherDetailedDebug_toolt: Enables prints into console.txt. Useful for debug purposes, also allows you to find data about internal counters. Ctrl+F for 'ETW' to find the loggers. Adds a lot of unneeded (for players) info into console.txt which might have performance impact the longer you play, enable this only when reporting bugs with console logs.

UI_ETW_Options_ParanoiaScreamVolume_tool: Client-side volume of the scream played when Paranoia makes your character yell. Muting it does not prevent zombies from hearing the yell.

UI_ETW_Options_TraitColumns_tooltip: How many columns are there in the UI on character page. Default setting should work good if you play in English language, but if text overlaps in other languages, you might want to reduce this value

UI_ETW_Vitals_Mental_tooltip: Records your anger, stress, unhappiness, and panic every in-game minute. These stats are normalized and averaged, then inverted so 1 represents the best mental state and 0 the worst. Minute samples are rolled into hourly averages, hourly samples into daily averages, and daily samples into the 31-day average shown here.
UI_trait_AVClubDesc: You are a part of the AV Club
UI_trait_ActionHeroDesc:
You live for the thick of the fight.
Your weapons deal half their normal damage when no enemies are nearby, but gain damage and critical chance for every living zombie within 10 tiles. Closer zombies provide larger bonuses.
UI_trait_AnemicDesc: You lose health more rapidly from unstemmed bleeding wounds.
UI_trait_AsceticDesc:
You reject elaborate food, comfortable sleep, and passive entertainment.
Simple food provides more fullness and calories. Boredom and unhappiness reductions from packaged food become increases instead. Prepared meals with two ingredients/spices provide no mood benefit; with three or more, their mood benefits become penalties.
Poor beds and bare floors feel good, good beds feel poor, and sleeping with a pillow always feels poor.
Television cannot reduce your boredom or unhappiness, and comic books provide no mood benefits. Ordinary books are unaffected. However, living such a simple life is what you are used to, and you your Boredom and Unhappiness are slowly reduces passively.

Due to technical limitations: The food always shows original benefits, the trait effect is applied when you eat an item. Same with beds and magazines, the bed tooltip shows non-Ascetic bed quality, but basically you just flip it. Comic books show original values too. This is a technical limitation that would require a LOT of work to bypass, so it's going to take some time, if it'll even be implemented at all.
UI_trait_AntiGunActivistDesc:
You have no experience with firearms and dislike using them.
Firearms take longer to aim, have reduced range, and make you unhappy while aiming or handling magazines.
You receive 25%% less Aiming and Reloading XP while between 5%% and 95%% progress through the current level.
UI_trait_BadTeethDesc: Eating may cause pain in your head. Larger portions cause more pain.
UI_trait_BlissfulDesc: You have a positive outlook. Unhappiness and boredom fade more quickly.
UI_trait_BouncerDesc:
You've roughed people up now and again.
When three or more zombies crowd around you, you may automatically stagger one of them.
UI_trait_IndefatigableDesc:
You are exceptionally difficult to kill.
Falling near death or having four zombies crowd within 1.5 tiles restores your health and endurance, removes fatigue, and knocks down zombies within 2.5 tiles. For two real-time minutes, pain and wound movement penalties are suppressed.
This does not close wounds or cure zombification.
UI_trait_SuperImmuneDesc: You are immune to the Knox Infection, ordinary wound infections, colds, and disease.
UI_trait_TerminatorDesc:
You handle firearms like a killing machine.
Firearms deal more damage, aim faster, reach farther, and jam less often. Aiming with one reduces panic and stress.
UI_trait_ButterfingersDesc:
You may drop held items while moving. Heavy loads and running make this more likely.
You may also accidentally drop items on the ground while transferring them.
UI_trait_DepressiveDesc:
You are prone to bouts of sadness.
You occasionally gain a large amount of unhappiness that slowly recedes until the episode ends.
UI_trait_SelfDestructiveDesc:
When the going gets tough, you crumble.
At high unhappiness, your health declines toward a floor determined by your unhappiness. Depressive makes the health loss more severe and its episodes more likely.
UI_trait_ImmunocompromisedDesc:
Your immune system is dangerously vulnerable.
Untreated wound infections worsen faster. Every new zombie injury may cause Knox infection, even when transmission is disabled.
UI_trait_AxeThrowerDesc: You have participated in axe throwing competitions
UI_trait_BladeEnthusiastDesc: A deep appreciation for edged weapons and the discipline to wield them effectively. You've honed your skills with long blades, making every strike count
UI_trait_BloodlustDesc:
You find great joy in culling the undead.
You gain happiness and lose stress and panic from killing zombies.
UI_trait_BodyWorkEnthusiastDesc: You enjoy repairing and restoring the bodies of old cars
UI_trait_FastEaterDesc: You waste no time eating. Food takes less time to consume.
UI_trait_FurnitureAssemblerDesc: You are a fan of putting together your own furniture
UI_trait_GunEnthusiastDesc: You enjoy handling firearms and go shooting at the range for fun
UI_trait_GymRatDesc:
You spent a lot of time at the gym getting swole.
Exercise grants twice as much Fitness and Strength XP, and exercise-fatigue buildup is reduced by half by default.
UI_trait_HoarderDesc:
You have trouble throwing anything away and tend to carry a lot of stuff with you.
You can carry additional load per each point of Strength
UI_trait_HomeCookDesc: You enjoy making your own meals and bake the occasional cake
UI_trait_GourmandDesc:
You delight in food of all kinds and enjoy cooking.
Food you cook cooks faster and takes longer to burn. Food you cook or prepare is more satisfying, and its temperature or preparation method does not bother you.
UI_trait_GordoniteDesc:
You are adept at using crowbars as weapons.
Crowbars deal more damage and have a higher critical chance based on your Long Blunt and Strength skills.
UI_trait_HardyDesc: You have a reserve of endurance beyond your normal limits.
UI_trait_IdealWeightDesc: Your metabolism helps draw your weight toward a healthy range.
UI_trait_LeadFootDesc:
You've always had a heavy step and now it's time to put your foot down—on some zombies.
Your stomps are considerably more powerful.
UI_trait_HomichlophileDesc: You like the fog, something about it makes you feel cosy. You get calmer while you're outside in foggy weather. You slowly lose stress and panic depending on fog intensity.
UI_trait_HomichlophobiaDesc: You hate the fog, something about it makes you feel alarmed and stressed. You get uneasy while you're outside in foggy weather. You slowly gain stress and panic depending on fog intensity (capped at 50%%).
UI_trait_KnifeFighterDesc: You have practiced how to fight with a knife
UI_trait_LightStepDesc: You are naturally light on your feet and make little sound moving
UI_trait_LowProfileDesc: You are a shady character and good at hiding
UI_trait_MadeOfGlassDesc:
You are exceptionally fragile.
Health loss is amplified, and sufficiently damaging impacts may scratch or fracture a random body part.
UI_trait_MundaneDesc:
Your weapon attacks never critically hit.
Other damage bonuses still apply normally.
UI_trait_NaturalEaterDesc:
You prefer natural foods over heavily preserved food.
Eating uncooked beans, berries, citrus, fruit, greens, mushrooms, nuts, or vegetables restores mental stats based on the portion's hunger value, up to 5%%.
UI_trait_NoodleLegsDesc:
You may trip while running or sprinting.
The chance decreases with your Sprinting and Nimble levels.
UI_trait_OlympianDesc: You are, or once were, an Olympic competitor whose fitness and speed reflect years of training.
UI_trait_PainToleranceDesc: You are resistant to pain, your pain level never go above specific percentage (60%% by default)
UI_trait_PackMouseDesc: You always travel light. Your maximum carrying capacity is reduced.
UI_trait_PackMuleDesc:
You know how to pack everything you need.
Your maximum carrying capacity is increased by 20%%.
UI_trait_ParanoiaDesc:
While moving, you may suffer a false zombie scare that sharply increases panic and stress and may cause you to scream, attracting nearby zombies.
Higher stress makes attacks more likely. After an attack, there is a cooldown before another can occur.
UI_trait_PetTherapyDesc:
You have always loved pets more than people. Petting animals gives you mood boost: reduces panic, boredom, unhappiness and stress.
By deafult, can only occur once every 5 min and gives 5%% mood boost. Adjustable in sandbox.
UI_trait_PluviophileDesc:
You love the rain and being under it. Slowly lose unhappiness, stress and boredom while being outside in rainy weather. Effect is halved if you're under umbrella.
You can stand under my umbrella, ella, ella, eh, eh, eh
Under my umbrella, ella, ella, eh, eh, eh
Under my umbrella, ella, ella, eh, eh, eh
Under my umbrella, ella, ella, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh
These fancy things will never come in between
You're part of my entity, here for infinity
When the world has took its part
When the world has dealt its cards
If the hand is hard, together we'll mend your heart
UI_trait_PluviophobiaDesc:
You hate the rain and being under it. Slowly gain unhappiness, stress and boredom while being outside in rainy weather. Effect is halved if you're under umbrella.
You can stand under my umbrella, ella, ella, eh, eh, eh
Under my umbrella, ella, ella, eh, eh, eh
Under my umbrella, ella, ella, eh, eh, eh
Under my umbrella, ella, ella, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh, eh
These fancy things will never come in between
You're part of my entity, here for infinity
When the world has took its part
When the world has dealt its cards
If the hand is hard, together we'll mend your heart
UI_trait_PolearmFighterDesc: You've mastered the art of fighting with long, pole-like weapons. From pitchforks to spears, you know how to keep threats at bay with reach and precision
UI_trait_ProwessBladeDesc:
Bladed weapons deal 20%% more damage and degrade more slowly.
Your Small Blade, Long Blade, and Axe levels increase their critical chance.
UI_trait_PracticedSwordsmanDesc: You never thought all that swordplay would have practical use.
UI_trait_ProwessBluntDesc:
Blunt weapons deal 20%% more damage and degrade more slowly.
Your Short Blunt and Long Blunt levels increase their critical chance.
UI_trait_ProwessSpearDesc:
Spears deal 20%% more damage and degrade more slowly.
Your Spear level increases their critical chance.
UI_trait_RestorationExpertDesc: You know how to restore old items to pristine condition. You have a chance to not gain penalties for multiple repairs
UI_trait_QuickRestDesc: You recover endurance faster while sitting on the ground or resting on furniture.
UI_trait_QuietDesc:
You used to startle your friends and co-workers. Now that innate stealth is paying off.
+1 Sneaking and +1 Lightfooted.
UI_trait_ScrapperDesc:
You know how to get the most out of discarded metal.
+1 Metalworking, +1 Maintenance, and +1 Blacksmithing.
UI_trait_SlowEaterDesc: You take your time eating. Food takes longer to consume.
UI_trait_SunSensitivityDesc:
You are extremely sensitive to sunlight.
Being outside during daylight causes progressively worsening head pain. Holding an umbrella reduces exposure and pain.
UI_trait_TavernBrawlerDesc:
You are more effective with improvised melee weapons.
They deal more damage and are less likely to lose condition. Especially fragile items receive larger bonuses, while improvised spears receive a smaller damage bonus and no durability benefit.
UI_trait_ThickBloodedDesc: You bleed more slowly from all wounds.
UI_trait_ThuggishDesc: Sure, you've capped a few knees in your time. That experience could prove useful.
UI_trait_UnwaveringDesc:
Low endurance, fatigue, and pain reduce your weapon damage much less.
Wounds impair your movement less.
UI_trait_StickFighterDesc: You have practiced stick fighting martial arts
UI_trait_WellFittedDesc: Worn clothing weighs less and imposes reduced running- and combat-speed penalties.
UI_trait_BloodlustOverwhelmingDesc: Your desire to kill is insatiable, and it only gets worse as you shower in blood of your enemies, having the time of your life.
